completeness.expectedCountMethod: Compare main leaderboard rows with rendered browser count, validate one numeric score and percent marker per row, and cross-check any numeric data-score attributes against visible text.

notes: Main leaderboard all-criteria task pass@1 percentages; professional instruction following.
The official harness defines all_pass/mean as the leaderboard task pass rate; mean_criteria/mean is separate.
Per-row trial count, benchmark version and publication date are unpublished.

originChecks.locator: .lead-main [data-leaderboard-row] (zero-based index 18) [data-score] (row 19: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision (experimental) (Max reasoning))

policy.notes: Inputs to `pnpm data:generate-display-set`. Maximising the number of complete models says nothing about which models, so the optimiser is free to reach its count by dropping one the leaderboard exists to show. requiredModelIds names the models every preset must be able to rank. Keep the list short: each entry narrows the search to benchmark subsets that model has, and the cost in benchmark count is reported by the generator.
